description: This file defines a custom helper class `ScalingOffsettingHelper` that extends `DefaultOffsettingHelper` to customize item scaling and alignment behavior in a `WearableRecyclerView`. It modifies child views based on their position, shrinking and aligning them in a scrollable wearable device interface.

classes.name: ScalingOffsettingHelper
classes.description: A custom helper class for scaling and positioning items in a WearableRecyclerView to enhance visual alignment and scaling effects during scrolling, particularly shrinking items as they move away from the center.

methods.name: updateChild
methods.description: Overrides the parent method to adjust the scale of each child view based on its position relative to the center of the parent, creating a shrinking effect when scrolling away from the center.
